{{Top|leg}}
'''Shovel-arms''', also known as '''Heavy Razing Arms''', were large [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manipulators equipped on [[Construction droid/Legends|construction droids]] such as the [[EVS Construction Droid]]. The shovel-arms were used to tear down structures scheduled for demolition, and then fed the useful debris into its processor mouth to begin the recycling process.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
